pool.text: Local leader Njewa established Lilongwe as a boma around this specific time.
Lilongwe officially became designated as an administrative centre.
Lilongwe received official recognition as a town trading post.
The first formal urban plan for Lilongwe was published.
Malawi president Hastings Kamuzu Banda selected Lilongwe as an economic growth point.
Consultants completed the comprehensive Lilongwe Master Plan.
The Lilongwe Outline Zoning Plan was established as the first plan.
Lilongwe officially became the capital of Malawi, replacing Zomba.
The Lilongwe Urban Structure Plan was produced as a result.
Lilongwe established a twinning agreement with Taipei in Taiwan.
The initial stage of urban development for the city was completed.
Lilongwe formed a twinning connection with Lusaka situated in Zambia.
The final government offices were successfully relocated to Lilongwe.
Area 58 was incorporated into the jurisdiction of the city.
The Minister of Lands approved the report on the urban development master plan.
The project for urban plan and development management began implementation with JICA support.
